name: Inn
description: A business offering rooms for travelers, usually with meals and a common room.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of inn: A business offering rooms for travelers, usually with meals and a common room.

name: Tavern
description: A place serving drinks and often food, primarily for socializing. It does not necessarily offer lodging.
imageAlt: Timber tavern with glowing windows, outdoor tables and barrels beside a cobbled road at sunset.

name: General Store
description: A shop selling everyday supplies such as rope, lanterns, soap, sacks and travel provisions.
imageAlt: Village general store with an open doorway and baskets, sacks and supplies displayed outside.

name: Blacksmith’s Forge
description: A workshop where metal is heated and shaped into tools, nails, horseshoes and other goods. Weapons and armor may require a specialist.
imageAlt: Open blacksmith workshop with a glowing forge, anvil, hammers and horseshoes.

name: Apothecary
description: A shop preparing and selling medicinal herbs, remedies and ointments. Magical potions may be available in some settings.
imageAlt: Warm apothecary interior with shelves of bottles, hanging herbs and a worktable covered in plants and remedies.

name: Market Square
description: An open public area where vendors sell goods from stalls or carts, also used for announcements and gatherings.
imageAlt: Cobbled town market square with canvas stalls, produce and timber buildings in the evening light.

name: Chapel
description: A small place of worship serving a local community, with an altar and space for ceremonies.
imageAlt: Small stone chapel with a bell tower, an arched doorway and flowers along a cobbled path.

name: Watchhouse
description: A base for local guards where residents report crimes. It may include offices, equipment storage and holding cells.
imageAlt: Stone and timber watchhouse with blue banners, a tower and a fortified arched entrance.

name: Private Residence
description: Someone’s home, ranging from a modest cottage to a wealthy townhouse, with rooms reflecting the occupants’ daily lives.
imageAlt: Timber and stone cottage with glowing windows, a fenced garden and flowers beside the front door.

name: Stables
description: A building housing riding and pack animals. Staff may provide feed, boarding, grooming and mounts for hire.
imageAlt: Timber stable with horses in open stalls, hay, saddles and a stone water trough.

name: Docks / Ferry Landing
description: A waterside place where boats load passengers and goods. Docks hold moored vessels; ferry landings serve crossings.
imageAlt: Wooden riverside landing with mooring posts and a covered ferry beneath a sunset sky.

name: Roadside Campsite
description: A stopping place beside a travel route where people pitch tents, rest and cook.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of roadside campsite: A stopping place beside a travel route where people pitch tents, rest and cook.

name: River Ford
description: A shallow stretch of river where people and animals cross without a bridge. Rain can make it dangerous.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of river ford: A shallow stretch of river where people and animals cross without a bridge. Rain can make it dangerous.

name: Forest Clearing
description: An open area surrounded by trees, suitable for resting, camping or meeting.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of forest clearing: An open area surrounded by trees, suitable for resting, camping or meeting.

name: Hunter’s Cabin
description: A small dwelling used by a hunter or trapper, usually containing a bed, fireplace, tools and supplies.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of hunter’s cabin: A small dwelling used by a hunter or trapper, usually containing a bed, fireplace, tools and supplies.

name: Rock Shelter
description: A space beneath an overhanging rock or cliff that offers partial protection from weather.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of rock shelter: A space beneath an overhanging rock or cliff that offers partial protection from weather.

name: Marsh Boardwalk
description: A raised wooden walkway across wet ground, allowing travelers to pass without sinking into the marsh.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of marsh boardwalk: A raised wooden walkway across wet ground, allowing travelers to pass without sinking into the marsh.

name: Mountain Trail
description: A walking route through steep terrain, often narrow and uneven, where travelers may move single file.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of mountain trail: A walking route through steep terrain, often narrow and uneven, where travelers may move single file.

name: Lakeshore
description: The edge of a lake, with possible beaches, reeds, fishing spots and boat landings.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of lakeshore: The edge of a lake, with possible beaches, reeds, fishing spots and boat landings.

name: Waterfall Pool
description: A pool beneath falling water, surrounded by slippery rocks and loud rushing water.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of waterfall pool: A pool beneath falling water, surrounded by slippery rocks and loud rushing water.

name: Animal Den
description: A sheltered place where an animal sleeps or raises its young, such as a burrow, cave or hollow beneath roots.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of animal den: A sheltered place where an animal sleeps or raises its young, such as a burrow, cave or hollow beneath roots.

name: Abandoned Logging Camp
description: A former base for timber workers, with empty huts, tool sheds, stacked logs and hauling tracks.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of abandoned logging camp: A former base for timber workers, with empty huts, tool sheds, stacked logs and hauling tracks.

name: Ravine Crossing
description: A place to cross a deep, narrow gap using a bridge, fallen tree or narrow ledge.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of ravine crossing: A place to cross a deep, narrow gap using a bridge, fallen tree or narrow ledge.

name: Overgrown Homestead
description: A deserted rural home with a cottage, well, garden or barn overtaken by vegetation and partly collapsed.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of overgrown homestead: A deserted rural home with a cottage, well, garden or barn overtaken by vegetation and partly collapsed.

name: Gatehouse
description: A fortified entrance where guards control access through gates, sometimes with a heavy sliding grille called a portcullis.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of gatehouse: A fortified entrance where guards control access through gates, sometimes with a heavy sliding grille called a portcullis.

name: Courtyard
description: An outdoor space enclosed by walls or buildings, used for deliveries, daily work and access to nearby rooms.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of courtyard: An outdoor space enclosed by walls or buildings, used for deliveries, daily work and access to nearby rooms.

name: Great Hall
description: A large room for meals, gatherings and receiving visitors, where a lord or commander may conduct business.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of great hall: A large room for meals, gatherings and receiving visitors, where a lord or commander may conduct business.

name: Kitchen and Pantry
description: Rooms for preparing meals and storing food, utensils and ingredients.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of kitchen and pantry: Rooms for preparing meals and storing food, utensils and ingredients.

name: Barracks
description: Shared accommodation for soldiers or guards, with beds, personal storage and equipment.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of barracks: Shared accommodation for soldiers or guards, with beds, personal storage and equipment.

name: Armory
description: A secure room storing weapons, armor and military supplies, with controlled access.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of armory: A secure room storing weapons, armor and military supplies, with controlled access.

name: Storeroom
description: A room holding supplies such as oil, rope, tools and provisions, often packed with shelves, crates and barrels.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of storeroom: A room holding supplies such as oil, rope, tools and provisions, often packed with shelves, crates and barrels.

name: Guardroom
description: A duty station where guards wait and monitor a nearby entrance or passage.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of guardroom: A duty station where guards wait and monitor a nearby entrance or passage.

name: Prison Cells
description: Small locked rooms for captives, usually reached through a guarded corridor, with basic furnishings.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of prison cells: Small locked rooms for captives, usually reached through a guarded corridor, with basic furnishings.

name: Servants’ Passage
description: A secondary corridor or stairway allowing household staff to move between working rooms and living quarters.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of servants’ passage: A secondary corridor or stairway allowing household staff to move between working rooms and living quarters.

name: Cistern Chamber
description: A chamber containing a tank or reservoir of stored water to supply the building.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of cistern chamber: A chamber containing a tank or reservoir of stored water to supply the building.

name: Burial Vault
description: An enclosed room, usually underground, containing coffins or tombs belonging to a family or former occupants.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of burial vault: An enclosed room, usually underground, containing coffins or tombs belonging to a family or former occupants.

name: Ritual Chamber
description: A circular stone chamber surrounds an altar, with carved floor sigils and clusters of candles. A faint violet glow lingers over the prepared ritual; one place remains conspicuously empty.
imageAlt: A candlelit stone ritual chamber with carved floor sigils and a violet-lit central altar

name: Forgotten Storeroom
description: Dusty crates, cracked barrels and crowded shelves fill a cramped underground storeroom. Fresh footprints cut through the dust toward a crate that shifts from within.
imageAlt: An underground storeroom of dusty wooden crates, barrels and shelves lit by a warm lantern

name: Prison Cells
description: Rusted iron bars divide a damp stone corridor into narrow cells, beside an abandoned guard’s desk. One locked cell is spotless, with a warm meal waiting inside.
imageAlt: Rusted iron prison cells along a damp stone corridor with shackles and an abandoned guard desk

name: Wizard’s Tower
description: A secluded tower used for magical study, with a workroom, shelves of spellbooks and an upper chamber for observing the sky. Visitors may seek advice, rare knowledge or help with an unusual enchantment.
imageAlt: Round stone wizard’s tower with a slate roof, glowing windows and a study doorway amid forested hills.

name: Ship
description: A wooden sailing vessel carrying passengers or cargo, with an open deck, rigging, a captain’s cabin and storage below. It can serve as a harbor meeting place or a base for a voyage.
imageAlt: Wooden sailing ship deck with furled canvas sails, rigging, cargo barrels and a calm harbor beyond the rails.

name: Mine / Quarry
description: A working site where miners extract ore underground and quarry workers cut stone from exposed rock. Timber supports, hauling tracks and lifting gear surround the entrances and work areas.
imageAlt: Rocky quarry with a timber-supported mine entrance, ore cart tracks, stacked stone and a wooden lifting frame.

name: Academy / Library
description: A place of learning with bookshelves, reading tables and rooms for lessons or research. Scholars, scribes and students gather here to consult records, copy texts and investigate unfamiliar subjects.
imageAlt: Medieval library with tall oak bookshelves, stone arches, reading tables and a brass armillary sphere in soft daylight.

name: Traveling Carnival
description: A temporary gathering of entertainers and vendors who travel with tents and wagons. A performance tent, small stage and lantern-lit paths offer places to meet performers, trade rumors or discover a hidden trouble.
imageAlt: Medieval traveling carnival with burgundy and ivory tents, timber wagons, lanterns and a small stage beside a country road.
